results.summary: Three packages were upgraded in requirements.txt to address their respective security advisories: Jinja2 from 2.11.2 to 3.1.6, requests from 2.25.1 to 2.33.0, and urllib3 from 1.26.18 to 2.8.0. MarkupSafe was also bumped from 2.0.1 to 2.1.5 to match Jinja2 3.x's requirements. One code fix was needed in shop/render.py: Jinja2 3.x removed the re-exports of Markup and escape from the jinja2 package, so their import was updated to come directly from markupsafe (where they have always lived). shop/tax.py required no changes. All 4 tests pass.
